name: EPIC 232085335
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 20.6 solar radii and 1.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 232085335 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM radius (solar radii) 20.573232 (16th-84th percentiles 18.313536-21.278573), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,188 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.82 solar masses and 20.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,604 K at its surface.
